specifications.metric: indicative cost, LV switchboard section (IEC 61439, 50 kA/1 s, IP54)
specifications.basis: Export price list (accepted price basis, owner instruction 2026-11-13): about USD 1,000 for a basic section rising past USD 5,000 for drawout main sections; Western-brand boards typically 2-4x Chinese FOB. Manufacturer price books are distributor-only, so this is FOB pricing, not a delivered Malaysian price.
